title: How an invoice is sent
summary: The cron job finds due invoices, queues them in Hermes, and notify.ts emails the customer.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[invoice.cron.ts finds due invoices] --> B[Hermes queue]
  B --> C[notify.ts sends email]
  C --> D[Invoice marked as sent]
outline: 2. They are put in the Hermes queue
4. The invoice is marked as sent
